Response to Bioconductor Review

Hello @jianhong, thank you for your review. I have addressed the comments point by point below, following the order of the review checklist.

General Package Development

Response: The package was developed independently and was not supported by an external grant or funding body. Therefore, no fnd role is applicable in Authors@R.

Response: No code has been copied from another software project or external source. Some package revisions, structuring, and formatting were assisted by OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex and Google Gemini. All changes were reviewed by the package author and are maintained under the package’s MIT license.

Assisted-by: OpenAI ChatGPT/Codex
Assisted-by: Google Gemini

R Code

Reviewer comment: In R/plotDEResults.R, direct access to result@params$cell_type and result@params$contrast was detected.

Response: Addressed. A public params() accessor for FDEResult has been added, exported, and documented. plotDEResults() now uses params(result) instead of direct slot access via result@params, so user-facing code no longer accesses the params slot directly. The params() method extends the existing S4Vectors::params generic to avoid namespace conflicts.

Reviewer comment: In R/fastDE.R, the column validation used an explicit for loop.

Response: Addressed. The column-validation for loop in fastDE() has been replaced with vapply()-based validation over the required metadata columns. This removes the reported explicit loop while preserving the same validation behavior.

Reviewer comment: In R/plotDEResults.R, explanation was requested for label_genes <- head(sig_genes, top_n).

Response: Addressed. In plotDEResults(), sig_genes is first filtered to retain only genes passing both FDR and log-fold-change thresholds, then sorted by ascending adjusted p-value. Therefore, head(sig_genes, top_n) selects the top N most statistically significant genes for volcano plot labelling.

head() is used here because sig_genes is a plain data.frame, produced from as.data.frame(deTable(result)), so head.data.frame() dispatch is deterministic and equivalent to explicit row subsetting. It also safely handles the case where fewer than top_n genes are significant by returning all available rows without error.

Reviewer comment: In R/plotDEResults.R, drop = FALSE was requested for data-frame subsetting of sig_genes.

Response: Addressed. The data-frame subsetting operations in plotDEResults() now explicitly use drop = FALSE when selecting significant genes and ordering them by adjusted p-value. This prevents accidental dimension reduction when only one row is selected.

Reviewer comment: Repeated validation logic was detected in fastPseudobulk() and filterSparseDonors().

Response: Addressed. The duplicated SingleCellExperiment and colData validation logic shared by fastPseudobulk() and filterSparseDonors() has been refactored into the internal helper .validate_sce_coldata() in R/utils.R. Both functions now call this helper for common metadata validation, while function-specific checks such as target_type, action, and min_cells remain local to the relevant function.
